<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern, the prominent M+1 peak (~11 % of the base peak) matches the natural abundance of ¹³C (≈1.1 % per carbon), indicating the presence of multiple carbon atoms. No other element shows a characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S) at the observed intensities, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
